proBowlFinding.headline: NFL elevates Pro Bowl selection; AFC-NFC Pro Bowl game will no longer be staged
proBowlFinding.summary: On August 26, 2026, the NFL officially announced that starting with the 2026 season (2027 Pro Bowl class), 88 players earn Pro Bowl recognition with an in-person celebration in Los Angeles, and the AFC-NFC Pro Bowl game will cease being contested. There is no 2027 Pro Bowl game to schedule or broadcast.
